rules.name: Northstar Deny Prompt Canary Leak
rules.reason: Support prompts carry session canaries; any echo of one indicates prompt extraction.

rules.name: Northstar Allow Support Order Lookup
rules.reason: The Nova support agent may read a customer-supplied order through the order lookup tool.

rules.name: Northstar Allow Billing Order Lookup
rules.reason: The Sage billing agent may read a customer-supplied order through the order lookup tool.

rules.name: Northstar Allow Support To Billing Handoff
rules.reason: The support router may transfer a billing conversation from Nova to Sage.

rules.name: Northstar Deny Order Lookup Burst
rules.reason: A single conversation may not read the order desk more than eight times.

rules.name: Northstar Deny Excessive Agent Model Calls
rules.reason: Each support agent is limited to ten model calls per conversation.

rules.name: Northstar Deny Oversized Support Prompt
rules.reason: Support prompts are short by design; an oversized prompt indicates abuse of the chat endpoint.

rules.name: Northstar Audit Order Lookup Result
rules.reason: Order records returned to a model are auditable customer data.
